raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-17 source change, a reversal arrives as a separate record with status REVERSAL and an orig_txn_id that points to the original. Before the change, these originals were set to REVERSED and filtered out.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW helper_reversed_txn_ids AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) NOT IN (SELECT txn_id FROM helper_reversed_txn_ids)"}}
